desc:
Welcome to Shepherd Simulator! 
How to Play:
🐑 Grow your flock and collect sheep
🌿 Send them to graze and boost production
🏡 Upgrade your sheepfold
🎲 Discover rare sheep
⚠️ Protect your flock from danger

💰 Earn coins and expand your herd!
🔥 Build the ultimate flock!

👍 Like the game and join our group!

I welcome all feedback and suggestions to improve my game! Feel free to share your thoughts!
